text: I find myself surrounded by symbols of innovation and learning, the walls adorned with bold colors and the promise of research. There is an air of anticipation here, as if something new could be discovered at any moment. I feel both curious and slightly unsettled by the sterility and brightness of the environment; it is a place designed for minds to gather, yet at this moment, it feels empty and echoing. The absence of people and the perfect arrangement of chairs hints at a pause before action—a thoughtful, almost meditative space.
